Excerpts of Infosys earnings-call transcripts (BSE filings, 2025-26) used by
tests/test_research.py. Sentences are copied verbatim from the filings; the surrounding
text is condensed (only the participants block, the guidance passages and a few
neighbouring turns are kept). `screener_infy.json` is a trimmed copy of screener.in's
consolidated quarterly table for the same company.

`chorus_style.txt` reproduces the layout most Indian transcripts use ("MANAGEMENT: MR. X
– ROLE – COMPANY" rosters wrapped over lines, a running page header, "Name: speech",
analysts introduced by the moderator, a broker host). Its roster and header lines are
copied from real filings; the spoken lines are written for the test.
